content.rendered:
Download Football Manager 2023 Mobile Apk Obb (FM 2023) with verification issues fixed, real names save data files available, face packs and kits updated, fixed real teams names also.

Football Manager 2023 Mobile game developed by Sega enables you to start your own football managerial career by coaching and training your own football team on your Android or iOS device, with the ability to buy and sell players, with so many other features available.

In FM 2023 Mod Apk obb, you can sell off your players during transfers windows who have dropped in performance and also buy high performing players which simulates the activities of real world of football.

Similarly, like Dream League Soccer,  as a Team manager, you can use Agents to scout for best players for your football clubs and make the best bargain as possible.

FM 2023 Mobile store is available for you to unlock extra ordinary features of the game, such features are In game Editor, Gold Coaching, Superstar, Join The Board etc.

Five Playable Nations can now be loaded when you want to create a football team to manage in FM 23 Mobile mod apk, this will enable you to access more players such as wonderkids.

Features Of Football Manager 2023 Mobile Apk

  • Licenced competitions such as UEFA champions league, UEFA Europa League, UEFA Europa Conference League etc.
  • Team talk
  • All football clubs and over 60 leagues added.
  • Wonderkids improved.
  • Face packs and team kits updated.
  • Fully offline.
  • No verification needed.
  • Real player names or save data files available.

Football Manager 2023 Mobile Mod now has Obb file combined together, click the download button below and start downloading latest version of FM 2023 Mod Apk.

How To Install

After downloading, make sure you allow installation of Apps from unknown source, then click on the downloaded apk file and install.

On Android 11 device above after launching or opening the game you will be asked to choose a folder where you can add save data files and other important files too. 

But you are advised to select documents folder as a place to save your save or load your Save Data files.

FM 2023 Mobile Save Data Files To Get Real Players Names

Below are the save data files for your favourite clubs in which you can load to Football Manager 2023 Mobile to get real player names.

Steps to load or use FM 2023 Mobile Save Data files (Android 5 to 10):

  1. Open installed Zarchiver Apk App.
  2. Click on downloaded save data file below.
  3. From options menu that comes up…
  4. Click “Extract”.
  5. Click on 0/Storage/emulated or something similar.
  6. Now click on Device Memory from the drop down menu.
  7. Scroll down a bit or look for “Documents Folder” and click it.
  8. Click Sport Interactive folder.
  9. Click “Football Manager 2023 Manager folder”.
  10. Finally click “games folder” and extract your downloaded save data file into the games folder.
